_note: v3.0 plan 12 (no-model lane, plumbing only): with the witness record on, the shared read carries no witness section and the claims are derived in code (speaker, narrator view, enabled members on stage, asides); they land in extras.witness keyed by the read's input range, a swipe inside that range drops the read, and no player surface changes. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-42-witness.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().memory.witness === false) throw new Error('the witness record is switched off'); if (!rt.witness.present()?.includes('arin')) throw new Error('arin is not in the present set: ' + JSON.stringify(rt.witness.present())); return { present: rt.witness.present() };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The bell rings over the square. Then, low, to Arin alone: the tower is cracked.
/sendas name=Arin I nod and say nothing to the others.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = ['WITNESS m=0 heard=narrator', 'SCENE_NONE', 'NO_DELTA'].join('\n'); await rt.runExtractionNow(); const audit = rt.getSnapshot().extraction.audits.at(-1); if (audit?.prompt.includes('WITNESS m=')) throw new Error('the read prompt still carries a witness section'); const state = rt.witness.state(); const read = state.reads.at(-1); if (!read || read.status !== 'accepted' || read.claims.length !== 2) throw new Error('the derived witness read did not land: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); const heard = read.claims.map((claim) => claim.heard.members.join()); if (heard[0] !== 'arin,narrator' || heard[1] !== 'arin') throw new Error('unexpected derived claims: ' + JSON.stringify(read.claims)); globalThis.__w42 = { readId: read.readId }; return { range: read.inputRange.from + '-' + read.inputRange.to, claims: read.claims.length };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)); return { authorView: false };

globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; const reply = ctx.chat[last]; reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'I shrug and look at the tower.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipeable: last };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const end = Date.now() + 15000; while (rt.witness.state().reads.some((read) => read.readId === globalThis.__w42.readId)) { if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('the swipe inside the read range did not drop the read'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200)); } const state = rt.witness.state(); if (!state.invalidated.some((row) => row.from <= 0 && row.to >= 0)) throw new Error('message 0 is not marked invalidated: ' + JSON.stringify(state.invalidated)); return { reads: state.reads.length, invalidated: state.invalidated };
